summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ]0; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when the control is buffered and False when not a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title with the title; CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests were appended to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, installed, or committed, so pytest, mypy, and Black remain unverified; the changes were checked by reading only.
